B0C7QQHMCX.title: WiFi Relay Switch 12V, eWeLink 5V USB DC 7-48V Smart Relay Module
bullets: 【WiFi Smart Relay & APP Control】Control connected devices remotely through the eWeLink APP using a 2.4GHz WiFi network. This 1-channel WiFi relay switch supports scheduling, countdown timers, smart scenes, device sharing and power-on state settings for flexible smart home automation.

【5V USB & DC 7-48V Input, Dry Contact Output】Power this WiFi relay module through the 5V USB port or the DC 7-48V screw terminals. The NO, COM and NC terminals provide potential-free dry contact output and do not supply voltage to the connected device. Suitable for compatible external switch inputs and DIY control circuits.

【Inching Momentary & Self-Locking Modes】 This WiFi relay supports two working modes. In Self-Locking mode, the relay stays ON or OFF until the next command. In Inching (Momentary) mode, the relay automatically turns OFF after a customizable delay set in the eWeLink APP, making it suitable for simulating a momentary push button in compatible garage door openers, access control systems and PC power switch circuits.

【Voice & Wireless Remote Control】Works with Amazon Alexa and Google Home for hands-free voice control after linking your eWeLink account. The module also supports compatible 2.4GHz wireless remote control for convenient local operation. Wireless remote control is an optional function; the remote transmitter is not included in the package.

【Easy Setup & 2.4GHz WiFi Only】Connect the relay module to a 5V USB power source or DC 7-48V supply, then follow the instructions in the eWeLink APP to add the device. Supports 2.4GHz WiFi networks only; 5GHz WiFi is not supported. The package includes the KR0548-1CH WiFi relay module only. Power supply and wireless remote control are not included.
PRODUCT MODEL : KR0548-1CH

bullets: 【Dry Contact Output】SONOFF MINI-D switch supports dry contact output, with both Normally Open (NO) and Normally Closed (NC) options. It can control devices such as boilers, garage doors, and access control systems that are operated by dry contact signals.
【Supports DC low power motors/solenoid valves】Suitable for small DC motors and solenoid valves up to 8 W (MINI-D outputs are not suitable for AC circuits).

【Supports AC/DC Input】Supports both AC and DC input, ensuring flexible installation in various environments. Please note, the MINI-D input cannot be connected to both AC and DC simultaneously. You must choose either AC or DC for the input, but not both at the same time.
